🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where(((divide(AdjAmount, ts_mean(AdjAmount, 20)) > 1) > 0), ts_std(divide(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20)), 15), multiply(ts_std(divide(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20)), 15), 0.7))
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjAmount, ts_mean(AdjAmount, 20))
  3. 3. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(AdjAmount, 20)
  4. 4. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(divide(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20)), 15)
  5. 5. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20))
  6. 6. ts_median —— 过去 N 天滚动中位数
    ts_median(Volume, 20)
  7. 7. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(ts_std(divide(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20)), 15), 0.7)
  8. 8. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(divide(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20)), 15)
  9. 9. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20))
  10. 10. ts_median —— 过去 N 天滚动中位数
    ts_median(Volume, 20)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 vol：volume
  2. 计算 median_vol：vol.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).median()
  3. 计算 vol_ratio：vol / median_vol
  4. 计算 raw：vol_ratio.滚动窗口(15, min_periods=15).std()
  5. 计算 high_liquidity：style_gate_liquidity_high > 0
  6. 计算 factor：np.where(high_liquidity, raw, raw * 0.7)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_volume_abnormality_liquidity_gated(df): df_copy = df.copy() vol = df_copy["str">'volume'] median_vol = vol.rolling(20, min_periods=20).median() vol_ratio = vol / median_vol.replace(0, np.nan) raw = vol_ratio.rolling(15, min_periods=15).std() high_liquidity = df_copy["str">'style_gate_liquidity_high'] > 0 factor = np.where(high_liquidity, raw, raw * 0.7) df_copy["str">'factor_volume_abnormality_liquidity_gated'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_volume_abnormality_liquidity_gated']
